title: Summer Side Of Life
lyrics_plain:
He came down through fields of green
On the summer side of life
His love was ripe
There were no illusions
On the summer side of life
Only tenderness
And if you saw him now
You'd wonder why-hy-hy he would cry
The whole day long
There were young girls everywhere
On the summer side of life
They talked all night
To the young men that they knew
On the summer side of life
Going off to fight
And if you saw them now
You'd wonder why-hy-hy they would cry
The whole day long
He came down through fields of green
On the summer side of life
He prayed all night
Then he walked into a house
Where love had been misplaced
His chance to waste
And if you saw him now
You'd wonder why-hy-hy he would cry
The whole day long
And if you saw him now
You'd wonder why-hy-hy
And if you saw him now
You'd wonder why-hy-hy
And if you saw him now
You'd wonder why-hy-hy
